title: Song
description: The words and intent of a film's music, authored at the score stage. This is the half VRGDG cannot supply: its Builder holds lyrics per timeline segment but never writes them. Sections and lines here are what the export writes into the Builder's lyric fields, and what a karaoke burn later reads times from.

style.description: Style/mood/genre as the generator wants it - comma-separated tags work best for ACE-Step, e.g. 'driving synthwave, female vocals, analog bass'. Do not put a tempo here; use requested_tempo_bpm.

instrumental.description: True for a score with no vocal. Sections may then carry empty lines and exist only to mark structure.

requested_tempo_bpm.description: What to ask the generator for. The delivered tempo is measured separately into beat_map and is the only one anything may time from.

sections.description: The song in order. Section labels double as the generator's structure tags.

label.description: intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro, instrumental, drop - written as the generator expects them

start_seconds.description: Filled in after the track is generated and aligned. Absent before that, which is the normal state at authoring time.

singer.description: Name of the character singing this line. Must match a character named in the cast_record - VRGDG resolves singers against the same reference subjects casting already writes, so no separate singer identity exists (PLAN WP6).

delivery.description: Vocal direction for the generator, e.g. 'whispered', 'belted', 'harmonies'. Kept apart from text so the words stay clean for display and captions.

action_note.description: What the singer is doing on this line. Crosses to VRGDG's lyric cue action_note; ignored by the audio generator.

source.description: generated: made by a music tool here. library: taken from music_library/. provided: the user brought the file. A provided or library track still gets a song record if its words matter.

asset_id.description: Id of the audio in the asset_manifest once the track exists. Absent while the song is still only words.
